title: Growth Operator (Distribution Owner)
description:
Distribution Owner (Growth Operator - NAU)


São Paulo (In-person)

Company: Umatch (Product-led Dating App)


About the Role


We’re hiring a Distribution Owner to take full responsibility for New Active Users (NAU) at Umatch.


This is a hands-on, execution-heavy role for someone who lives and breathes acquisition, experimentation, and channel resilience.


This role operates under real platform risk - channels will degrade, metrics will drop, and decisions must be made without certainty.


This role requires independent judgment, prior exposure to channel decay, and end-to-end ownership of growth outcomes.


You will own New Active Users end-to-end, with direct accountability for outcomes - not activity.


That includes diagnosing channel degradation, running experiments, killing what doesn’t work, and building a system that survives platform changes.


This is not a brand role.

This is not a strategy-only role.

This is not a people management role.

This is about ownership, speed, and judgment .


What You’ll Do


  • Own New Active Users (NAU) as a core company metric
  • Diagnose and mitigate acquisition channel degradation
  • Design and run continuous growth experiments
  • Identify and test new acquisition channels
  • Reduce dependency on fragile platforms
  • Build clear dashboards and scenario forecasts
  • Make fast, disciplined decisions under uncertainty
  • Execute, monitor, and adjust acquisition efforts daily
  • Work closely with product, marketing, and operations
  • Transfer learnings to future products


We’re Looking For Someone Who


  • Has lived through channel decay or platform enforcement
  • Is comfortable operating without playbooks
  • Thinks in systems, not single channels
  • Runs experiments with discipline
  • Acts fast without being reckless
  • Communicates clearly and directly
  • Is emotionally stable and ego-free
  • Takes responsibility for outcomes


Must-Haves


  • Experience owning growth or acquisition metrics
  • Proven experimentation mindset
  • High autonomy and accountability
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • Has operated growth beyond clean paid channels or in constrained environments
  • Strong analytical intuition - comfortable making decisions with imperfect data


What This Role Is NOT


❌ Not a Head of Marketing

❌ Not a Brand role

❌ Not a People Manager

❌ Not a Strategy-only role

❌ Not for people who need stable conditions to perform


Why This Role Matters


Distribution is a core system at Umatch.


This role exists to ensure the company is never hostage to a single channel - and to build the foundation for future global products.


If you’ve already seen channels break - and know how to respond - we want to talk.

title: Release Manager
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

The IT Release Manager II will plan, coordinate, ensure notifications are sent in a timely manner, and schedule software releases in alignment with organizational strategy and goals. This role works closely with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure the quality and timeliness of releases , monitor and report progress during the release windows, and identify areas for improvement through testing feedback. The position also develops reports and metrics to communicate release performance to leadership.


Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, communicate, schedule, and facilitate software releases to meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with development, QA, operations, and change management teams to ensure readiness and quality.
  • Monitor and communicate release progress, identify risks, and escalate issues as needed.
  • Facilitate release meetings and maintain release calendars.
  • Review testing outcomes and work with QA to address defects and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain release documentation, including release notes and rollback plans.
  • Produce reports and metrics on release performance and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with InComm’s release management policies and best practices.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives for release processes.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred.
  • 4+ years of experience in release coordination, change management, or related IT governance roles.
  • Familiarity with SDLC processes and testing practices.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills; ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, or similar for tracking and documentation.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
  • Understanding of release governance, risk management, and quality assurance principles.
  • Analytical skills to interpret metrics and identify process improvements.
  • Comfortable working in Agile or iterative development environments.


Benefits

R$340 home office allowance

️ R$1,150 meal/food allowance (VR/VA)

10% annual bonus

Sul América health/dental plan

title: Media Buyer (Meta Ads)
description:
Campaign Manager Needed– up to $1,200 USD monthly!

REMOTE (WORK FROM HOME) JOB: THIS JOB IS AVAILABLE FOR APPLICANTS IN SOUTH AMERICA.

BEFORE YOU READ THE JOB DESCRIPTION:

1. Please complete the application process in ENGLISH. English proficiency must be fluent. Written and spoken English will be evaluated.

2. Must be freelance, NOT part of another agency already.


WHO ARE WE? FOUNTAIN FORWARD

We are a hyper-motivated crew of internet marketing experts based in Houston, Texas. We're on a mission to provide truly profitable data-driven marketing solutions, primarily for The Automotive industry and Roofers.

We love working together to accomplish one thing: persuade people to do business with our clients, and do it more often. Seeing our clients make more money and collaborating together to accomplish their goals is what drives us to slam down a couple of espressos every morning and fire up our brain cells.


HOW TO APPLY

Please complete our application form below:


JOB DESCRIPTION

Fountain Forward is looking for a Campaign Manager who will be responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing multi-channel marketing campaigns to achieve our clients' objectives and drive business growth. You will work closely with internal teams and clients to develop and implement strategic marketing initiatives across various digital and traditional channels. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and has a proven track record of successfully managing campaigns from conception to completion.


WHAT YOU’LL DO
  • You are the main person who executes any campaign-related work for our clients - that includes most of the new client onboarding, Facebook ad campaign building, and ongoing monthly recurring tasks for clients.
  • Most of our work is set up in templates - but you will be editing the details to make sure they 100% match what is needed to be customized in any fields in email campaigns, text message campaigns, and ad campaigns, with precision and speed.
  • You must be technologically savvy - we may use new tools for automating processes on a regular basis, so you will need to be able to take on new software tools often and be able to become an expert in using them quickly.
  • We are disciplined and process-focused, so we will need you to match this principle as well.
  • Develop comprehensive campaign strategies aligned with client goals, target audience, and market trends.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including creative, digital marketing, and sales, to execute integrated campaigns across multiple channels, such as email, social media, paid advertising, and events.
  • Manage campaign timelines, budgets, and resources to ensure timely delivery and optimal performance.
  • Conduct thorough market research and analysis to identify opportunities, trends, and insights that inform campaign strategies and tactics.
  • Monitor campaign performance metrics, analyze data, and generate actionable insights to optimize campaign effectiveness and ROI.
  • Prepare regular reports and presentations to communicate campaign results, recommendations, and insights to internal stakeholders and clients.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in campaign management and digital marketing.

    • REQUIRED SKILLS
    • 2+ Years Experience managing digital campaigns
    • Proven experience in campaign management, marketing, or related role, preferably in the Automotive Marketing Industry.
    • Proficiency in digital marketing platforms, analytics tools, and project management software. 
    • Excellent attention to detail, especially with communication (written and verbal) and meeting deadlines
    • Excellent proficiency in Facebook Advertising
    • Knowledge of Google Analytics or other optimization tools
    • Quickly develop proficiency in Google Ads and Amazon Ads
    • Comfortable managing and optimizing digital advertising accounts with large budgets
    • Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment
    • Professional communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.
    • Prior experience with digital marketing agencies preferred

    • ADDITIONAL INFORMATION HOW WE WORK

    - Freedom and flexibility. We’re a team working from around the world. That is, as long as they show up on our weekly calls, do their job correctly, and have a good sense of accountability.

    - Autonomy and ownership. Working on a distributed team means you don’t have someone micromanaging you or looking over your shoulder to make sure you’re getting things done. We’re a team of do-ers who take full ownership for their results.

    - Be helpful and dedicated. We help our clients be successful. We help our prospects get the right information and make the right decision whether or not it includes our services. We help our team members reach their full potential.


    THE PERKS!


    • Remote-First Culture:  Work from home—or anywhere in the world. We value results, not where you log in from.
    • Flexible Schedule:  We offer flexibility in your daily schedule (within reason) to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
    • Unlimited Paid Time Off:  Enjoy an unlimited vacation policy with just two weeks’ notice and manager approval. We also offer paid sick days because your well-being matters.
    • Parental Leave:  We understand the importance of supporting our team members during significant life events. Our maternity and paternity leave policy ensures you can prioritize your growing family without added stress.
    • Room to Grow : We’re a fast-growing company with massive opportunities for upward mobility. As we grow, you grow with us.
    • Professional Development:  Get access to training in digital marketing, advertising, and leadership to sharpen your skills and advance your career.
    • Quarterly Performance Bonuses : Earn bonuses based on your performance and contributions to the company’s success.
    • Paid Referral Program:  Earn rewards for referring great talent to join our team!
    • Health & Fitness Reimbursement (upon tenure):  Get support for health insurance or a gym membership—because your well-being matters.

title: Growth Operator (Distribution Owner)
description:
Distribution Owner (Growth Operator - NAU)


São Paulo (In-person)

Company: Umatch (Product-led Dating App)


About the Role


We’re hiring a Distribution Owner to take full responsibility for New Active Users (NAU) at Umatch.


This is a hands-on, execution-heavy role for someone who lives and breathes acquisition, experimentation, and channel resilience.


This role operates under real platform risk - channels will degrade, metrics will drop, and decisions must be made without certainty.


This role requires independent judgment, prior exposure to channel decay, and end-to-end ownership of growth outcomes.


You will own New Active Users end-to-end, with direct accountability for outcomes - not activity.


That includes diagnosing channel degradation, running experiments, killing what doesn’t work, and building a system that survives platform changes.


This is not a brand role.

This is not a strategy-only role.

This is not a people management role.

This is about ownership, speed, and judgment .


What You’ll Do


  • Own New Active Users (NAU) as a core company metric
  • Diagnose and mitigate acquisition channel degradation
  • Design and run continuous growth experiments
  • Identify and test new acquisition channels
  • Reduce dependency on fragile platforms
  • Build clear dashboards and scenario forecasts
  • Make fast, disciplined decisions under uncertainty
  • Execute, monitor, and adjust acquisition efforts daily
  • Work closely with product, marketing, and operations
  • Transfer learnings to future products


We’re Looking For Someone Who


  • Has lived through channel decay or platform enforcement
  • Is comfortable operating without playbooks
  • Thinks in systems, not single channels
  • Runs experiments with discipline
  • Acts fast without being reckless
  • Communicates clearly and directly
  • Is emotionally stable and ego-free
  • Takes responsibility for outcomes


Must-Haves


  • Experience owning growth or acquisition metrics
  • Proven experimentation mindset
  • High autonomy and accountability
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • Has operated growth beyond clean paid channels or in constrained environments
  • Strong analytical intuition - comfortable making decisions with imperfect data


What This Role Is NOT


❌ Not a Head of Marketing

❌ Not a Brand role

❌ Not a People Manager

❌ Not a Strategy-only role

❌ Not for people who need stable conditions to perform


Why This Role Matters


Distribution is a core system at Umatch.


This role exists to ensure the company is never hostage to a single channel - and to build the foundation for future global products.


If you’ve already seen channels break - and know how to respond - we want to talk.

title: Medical Science Liaison - Dermatology - Brazil
description:
Canopy Life Sciences is a well-respected vendor & partner in the life sciences industry, assisting pharmaceutical and life sciences clients in various functional areas of expertise. Our culture is one of empowerment. Everyone has a voice and plays a role in the success of the business and a role in developing our values & behaviors. We recruit, train, and develop people to ensure the very best for our client partners.



Medical Science Liaison – Dermatology - Brazil


This role requires a professional with a strong background in dermatology or rheumatology, extensive experience supporting clinical trials, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will serve as a key scientific resource, building relationships with stakeholders, facilitating clinical trial activities, and generating insights to inform strategy and improve patient outcomes.


Key Responsibilities:


Clinical Trial Support :


  • Collaborate with clinical trial teams to support trial enrollment efforts, including identifying suitable patients and optimizing recruitment strategies.
  • Engage with clinical trial sites and investigators to ensure smooth trial operations and alignment with study objectives.
  • Provide education and training to clinical sites on study protocols and therapeutic areas.


Insight Generation and Framework Creation :


  • Gather and synthesize insights from healthcare professionals (HCPs), patients, and other stakeholders to identify referral patterns, challenges, and opportunities for trial enrollment.
  • Develop frameworks to streamline patient identification and referral pathways.


Stakeholder Engagement :


  • Build and maintain relationships with HCPs, clinical trial investigators, and other key opinion leaders (KOLs) in dermatology.
  • Act as a liaison between clinical sites, investigators, and internal teams to ensure effective communication and support.


Cross-Border Collaboration :


  • Work across national borders to address global clinical trial needs and ensure compliance with international regulations and cultural nuances.
  • Collaborate with global teams to align on strategies and share best practices.


Travel Requirements :


  • Travel extensively to meet with stakeholders, support trial sites, and attend relevant conferences and events.


Independent Work :


  • Operate autonomously to manage responsibilities, meet deadlines, and drive projects forward while maintaining alignment with organizational goals.


Qualifications and Experience:


  • A minimum of 3 years of experience as a Medical Science Liaison or in a similar role.
  • Strong background in dermatology or rheumatology, with experience engaging with dermatologist-focused clinical trial sites and investigators.
  • Proven track record of supporting clinical trial enrollment, patient identification, and site engagement.
  • Experience generating insights and developing frameworks to address complex challenges in clinical trial operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify patient referral patterns and address barriers to patient participation.
  • Willingness to travel extensively, including international travel.
  • Experience working in cross-border settings and collaborating with global teams.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to work independently.


Preferred Qualifications:


  • Advanced degree (e.g., PharmD, PhD, MD) in a relevant field is highly desirable.
  • Experience with insight generation in the context of dermatology or rheumatology clinical trials.
  • Knowledge of global regulatory environments and best practices in clinical trial management.




Compensation - DOE

title: Junior Shopper Insights Client Associate
description:
dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, partnering with the world’s most ambitious retailers and brands to put the customer at the heart of every decision. We combine deep insight, advanced technology, and close collaboration to help our clients grow, innovate, and deliver measurable value for their customers.

dunnhumby employs nearly 2,500 experts in offices throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas working for transformative, iconic brands such as Tesco, Coca-Cola, Nestlé, Unilever and Metro.


Summary: We are seeking a Junior Shopper Insights Client Associate who is eager to advance their career by becoming a trusted partner to key clients. This role involves building strong relationships to define and deliver on clients' strategic needs, utilizing world-leading customer data to drive change and growth for our clients and the dunnhumby business.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and nurture relationships with new and existing client stakeholders, establishing trust and partnership.
  • Translate complex data into actionable insights and clear recommendations for client growth.
  • Communicate effectively and impactfully with clients to drive business outcomes.
  • Employ a consultative approach to identify client needs and propose relevant solutions.
  • Collaborate with solutions managers and media managers to deliver high-impact projects.
  • Contribute to the commercial team by working on projects with short and long-term impacts.


Required Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools and software.
  • Experience in client relationship management is a plus.


What you can expect from us

We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.

And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.


Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

description:

Com a aquisição do grupo BIG, em junho de 2022, demos início a mais uma etapa da nossa jornada que já dura 47 anos no Brasil. Unimos o melhor dos dois grupos e somos agora uma empresa mais diversa, com maior capacidade de inovar e causar impacto positivo na sociedade. Além de gerar mais de R$ 100 Bilhões em receitas e liderança no setor de 23% de Market Share.

Estamos investindo fortemente na simplificação e na aceleração digital, pois acreditamos que esse é o caminho para nos transformar e sermos protagonistas da mudança que queremos ver no país.

Trabalhar no Grupo Carrefour Brasil é participar diariamente de tudo isso, em um ambiente que respeita e acolhe as diferenças com muito espaço para crescer e aprender. Somos muitos e queremos ser ainda mais.

E você também pode fazer parte dessa grande jornada. Com você, seremos ainda maiores.


Localização: Próximo a ponte do Tatuapé


DO DISCURSO À PRÁTICA

• Realizar apuração de ICMS e Cumprimento de obrigações acessórias;

• Realizar pagamento de ICMS de diversos estados;

• Realizar conciliação fiscal/contábil dos estabelecimentos.

• Cursando ensino superior em Ciências Contábeis ou Administração;

• Experiência em apuração de ICMS.

• Conhecimento intermediário em Excel.

title: Instrutor(a) de Programação e Robótica
description:
Descrição da Empresa Ctrl+Play é uma rede de franquias de escolas de programação e robótica voltada para crianças e adolescentes, incentivando o aprendizado por meio de ferramentas lúdicas e educacionais. Com foco em capacitar jovens a entender e contribuir para o mundo tecnológico, oferecemos cursos para criação de jogos, aplicativos, websites e robôs. Nossos métodos de ensino são interativos, combinando atividades práticas e ferramentas desenvolvidas por organizações renomadas como MIT, Microsoft e Google.

Este é um cargo de tempo integral, presencial, localizado em Bauru, SP.

O(a) profissional atuará como um facilitador do processo de aprendizagem, incentivando o desenvolvimento criativo e lógico dos alunos.


Qualificações

  • Programação e Robótica: Conhecimento em linguagens de programação e conceitos básicos de robótica para ensinar de forma prática e eficiente.
  • Educação em STEM: Experiência ou interesse em ensinar disciplinas relacionadas à ciência, tecnologia, engenharia e matemática.
  • Treinamento e Comunicação: Habilidades para conduzir treinamentos, comunicar-se de maneira clara e estimular o aprendizado colaborativo.
  • Ter formação ou experiência em áreas como tecnologia, engenharia, informática ou educação é um diferencial.
  • Atitude positiva, paciência e entusiasmo para trabalhar com crianças e adolescentes são qualidades altamente valorizadas.

title: DevOps Specialist
description:
Olá Rede,


Somos uma empresa consolidada na área de Tecnologia e estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista DevOps, no modelo 100% remoto.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Superior em Análise de Sistemas, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência em funções de DevOps, SRE, Engenharia de Plataforma ou SysOps.
  • Conhecimento profundo e prático com orquestração de container Docker, Kubernetes, Rancher, OpenShift, Azure Red Hat Openshift, Red Hat Openshift Service on AWS.
  • Experiência comprovada em implantação, atualização e sustentação de Openshift.
  • Experiência comprovada com Ansible e Terraform para automação e gerenciamento de configuração.
  • Vivência na implementação e gestão de RH-SSO, Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, AWS IAM, WSO2.
  • Conhecimento na implantação e gestão do 3scale, Kong, Azure API management, Amazon API Gateway.
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de nuvem híbrida e provedores de nuvem pública (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Habilidades em scripting (Shell, Python ou Go) e Git para controle de versão.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e práticas de DevOps (CAMS - Cultura, Automação, Medição e Compartilhamento).
  • Experiência com serviços de missão crítica com alta disponibilidade.
  • Conhecimento sólido com infraestrutura de TI, sistemas operacionais e redes.
  • Experiência com esteiras CI/CD utilizando ferramentas Jenkins, Gitlab, Github, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps e AWS CodeComit.


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações Red Hat (ex: Red Hat Certified Engineer - RHCE, Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration).
  • Certificações AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified SysOps Administrator.
  • Certificações Azure AZ-104 Azure Adminsitrator Associate, AZ-305 Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AZ-400 DevOps Engineer Expert.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Prometheus, Grafana, ELK ou Dynatrace.


Importante:

  • Regime CLT | Jornada integral.
  • Nível de experiência: Senior.
  • Oportunidade 100% Home Office.


Salário e Benefícios:

  • Faixa Salarial: entre R$ 13.000,00 e 14.000,00.
  • Benefícios: Assistência Médica, Odontológica, Vale Refeição, PLR, Auxilio Home Office, Seguro de Vida, Vale Transporte, Auxílio Creche, Wellhub, Previdência Privada, Cursos Alura e Day Off.

title: Growth Operator (Distribution Owner)
description:
Distribution Owner (Growth Operator - NAU)


São Paulo (In-person)

Company: Umatch (Product-led Dating App)


About the Role


We’re hiring a Distribution Owner to take full responsibility for New Active Users (NAU) at Umatch.


This is a hands-on, execution-heavy role for someone who lives and breathes acquisition, experimentation, and channel resilience.


This role operates under real platform risk - channels will degrade, metrics will drop, and decisions must be made without certainty.


This role requires independent judgment, prior exposure to channel decay, and end-to-end ownership of growth outcomes.


You will own New Active Users end-to-end, with direct accountability for outcomes - not activity.


That includes diagnosing channel degradation, running experiments, killing what doesn’t work, and building a system that survives platform changes.


This is not a brand role.

This is not a strategy-only role.

This is not a people management role.

This is about ownership, speed, and judgment .


What You’ll Do


  • Own New Active Users (NAU) as a core company metric
  • Diagnose and mitigate acquisition channel degradation
  • Design and run continuous growth experiments
  • Identify and test new acquisition channels
  • Reduce dependency on fragile platforms
  • Build clear dashboards and scenario forecasts
  • Make fast, disciplined decisions under uncertainty
  • Execute, monitor, and adjust acquisition efforts daily
  • Work closely with product, marketing, and operations
  • Transfer learnings to future products


We’re Looking For Someone Who


  • Has lived through channel decay or platform enforcement
  • Is comfortable operating without playbooks
  • Thinks in systems, not single channels
  • Runs experiments with discipline
  • Acts fast without being reckless
  • Communicates clearly and directly
  • Is emotionally stable and ego-free
  • Takes responsibility for outcomes


Must-Haves


  • Experience owning growth or acquisition metrics
  • Proven experimentation mindset
  • High autonomy and accountability
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • Has operated growth beyond clean paid channels or in constrained environments
  • Strong analytical intuition - comfortable making decisions with imperfect data


What This Role Is NOT


❌ Not a Head of Marketing

❌ Not a Brand role

❌ Not a People Manager

❌ Not a Strategy-only role

❌ Not for people who need stable conditions to perform


Why This Role Matters


Distribution is a core system at Umatch.


This role exists to ensure the company is never hostage to a single channel - and to build the foundation for future global products.


If you’ve already seen channels break - and know how to respond - we want to talk.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Mintegral

Mintegral is a leading global mobile advertising platform, delivering AI-driven performance solutions for advertisers and premium monetization opportunities for app developers. With strong expertise in mobile UA, programmatic advertising, and SDK-based supply, Mintegral works with top advertisers, agencies, and publishers worldwide to drive sustainable growth.

As part of our continued expansion in Latin America, we are looking for a Business Manager based in São Paulo to accelerate Mintegral’s growth across the LATAM region.

Role Overview

The Business Manager, LATAM will play a critical role in driving Mintegral’s business expansion across Latin America. This role will focus on building strategic partnerships, growing revenue, supporting key accounts, and strengthening Mintegral’s market presence with advertisers, agencies, and app publishers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive business development and revenue growth for Mintegral across LATAM, with a strong focus on Brazil, Mexico, and other key regional markets
  • Build and manage relationships with advertisers, agencies, and mobile app developers, especially within performance marketing and UA
  • Identify new growth opportunities, partnerships, and vertical expansion across gaming and non-gaming sectors
  • Collaborate closely with global teams (Sales, Account Management, Product, and Operations) to support onboarding, campaign scaling, and performance optimization
  • Provide local market insights on LATAM trends, advertiser demand, pricing, and competitive landscape
  • Support go-to-market initiatives, industry events, and partner meetings in the region
  • Act as a regional point of contact, ensuring smooth communication between LATAM partners and global stakeholders

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in mobile advertising, ad tech, or digital performance marketing
  • Proven experience in business development, sales, or account management within the mobile ecosystem
  • Strong understanding of mobile UA, programmatic advertising, DSP/SSP, SDK-based supply, or monetization platforms
  • Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish (written and spoken)
  • Strong network and familiarity with the LATAM mobile advertising market, especially Brazil
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate in a fast-growing, global organization

Why Join Mintegral

Be part of a fast-growing global ad tech company with strong technology and premium mobile inventory

Opportunity to build and shape Mintegral’s LATAM business from the ground up

Work closely with international teams and global partners

Competitive compensation and growth opportunities

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Mintegral

Mintegral is a leading global mobile advertising platform, delivering AI-driven performance solutions for advertisers and premium monetization opportunities for app developers. With strong expertise in mobile UA, programmatic advertising, and SDK-based supply, Mintegral works with top advertisers, agencies, and publishers worldwide to drive sustainable growth.

As part of our continued expansion in Latin America, we are looking for a Business Manager based in São Paulo to accelerate Mintegral’s growth across the LATAM region.

Role Overview

The Business Manager, LATAM will play a critical role in driving Mintegral’s business expansion across Latin America. This role will focus on building strategic partnerships, growing revenue, supporting key accounts, and strengthening Mintegral’s market presence with advertisers, agencies, and app publishers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive business development and revenue growth for Mintegral across LATAM, with a strong focus on Brazil, Mexico, and other key regional markets
  • Build and manage relationships with advertisers, agencies, and mobile app developers, especially within performance marketing and UA
  • Identify new growth opportunities, partnerships, and vertical expansion across gaming and non-gaming sectors
  • Collaborate closely with global teams (Sales, Account Management, Product, and Operations) to support onboarding, campaign scaling, and performance optimization
  • Provide local market insights on LATAM trends, advertiser demand, pricing, and competitive landscape
  • Support go-to-market initiatives, industry events, and partner meetings in the region
  • Act as a regional point of contact, ensuring smooth communication between LATAM partners and global stakeholders

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in mobile advertising, ad tech, or digital performance marketing
  • Proven experience in business development, sales, or account management within the mobile ecosystem
  • Strong understanding of mobile UA, programmatic advertising, DSP/SSP, SDK-based supply, or monetization platforms
  • Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish (written and spoken)
  • Strong network and familiarity with the LATAM mobile advertising market, especially Brazil
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate in a fast-growing, global organization

Why Join Mintegral

Be part of a fast-growing global ad tech company with strong technology and premium mobile inventory

Opportunity to build and shape Mintegral’s LATAM business from the ground up

Work closely with international teams and global partners

Competitive compensation and growth opportunities

title: Supervisor de finanças
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor Financeiro para atuar em uma empresa do ramo de Construção Civil. O profissional será responsável por garantir a eficiência, a conformidade e a integração das rotinas financeiras relacionadas a Contas a Pagar, Contas a Receber, Central de Notas e Tesouraria , assegurando o correto fluxo de caixa, o cumprimento de prazos, a acuracidade das informações financeiras e o atendimento às normas internas e legais da empresa.


Principais responsabilidades:

  •     Supervisionar o processamento e a programação de pagamentos a fornecedores, impostos, encargos e demais obrigações.
  •   Garantir o cumprimento dos prazos acordados e a correta classificação contábil das despesas.
  •  Validar documentos, contratos e autorizações de pagamento conforme políticas internas.
  •  Controlar adiantamentos, reembolsos e conciliações relacionadas.
  • Supervisionar o faturamento, a emissão de boletos, notas fiscais e demais títulos de cobrança.
  •  Acompanhar a carteira de recebíveis, controlando vencimentos, inadimplência e provisões.
  • Atuar na gestão de crédito e cobrança, propondo ações para redução da inadimplência.
  • Garantir a correta baixa e conciliação dos recebimentos.
  •  Coordenar a recepção, conferência, validação e lançamento de notas fiscais (entrada e saída).
  •  Assegurar conformidade fiscal, tributária e documental das notas.
  • Interagir com áreas internas e fornecedores para correção de divergências fiscais.
  • Garantir o correto arquivamento físico e/ou digital dos documentos fiscais.
  •  Supervisionar o controle diário do fluxo de caixa e saldos bancários.
  • Acompanhar movimentações financeiras, aplicações, resgates e conciliações bancárias.
  • Apoiar a elaboração e o acompanhamento do fluxo de caixa projetado
  • Garantir a correta execução das rotinas de tesouraria conforme políticas financeiras
  •  Liderar, orientar e desenvolver a equipe financeira.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas, políticas internas e controles internos.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo informações e documentações
  •  Propor melhorias nos processos financeiros e na utilização de sistemas (ERP).
  • Elaborar e analisar relatórios gerenciais para suporte à tomada de decisão.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  •  Experiência prévia em rotinas financeiras, com atuação em contas a pagar, contas a receber, tesouraria e/ou área fiscal.
  • Domínio rotinas financeiras e de tesouraria; moções de legislação fiscal e tributária; conciliação bancária e fluxo de caixa; sistemas ERP e Excel intermediário/avançado.
  •  Experiência em supervisão ou coordenação de equipes financeiras.


Remuneração: Compatíveis com o mercado. Nível pleno.


Benefícios: Adiantamento de salário. Assistência médica. Assistência odontológica. Café da manhã. Refeitório. Seguro de vida. Vale refeição. Vale transporte. Cesta de natal.


Formato de trabalho: Presencial na região centro sul de Belo Horizonte.

title: Técnico de Operação e Serviço Remoto
description:
Descrição da vaga:


Olá, somos a Central IT!

Na Central IT, acreditamos em eficiência exponencial que impacta negócios.

Nossa missão é elevar a performance das organizações, conectando pessoas, processos e tecnologias às estratégias de negócio.

Somos uma empresa de Serviços Especializados em Gestão, Tecnologia e Negócios, movida pelo propósito de gerar valor real e sustentável para clientes e parceiros.

Aqui, cada projeto é conduzido com base em nossos valores fundamentais:

• Aperfeiçoamento;

• Resolutividade;

• Integridade;

• Comprometimento;

• Efetividade;

• Negociação;

• Sustentabilidade.


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa de Suporte Técnico para compor o time da Central IT e transformar o futuro com a gente!


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Cultivar bons relacionamentos com os nossos clientes;
  • Prestar atendimento remoto ao usuário, seguindo a base de conhecimento ou realizando acesso remoto com objetivo de sanar a ocorrência;
  • Realizar abertura de chamado pela ferramenta utilizada para registrar o incidente/requisição referente a ocorrências de falhas, priorizar incidentes (falsos positivos versus problemas críticos) e acompanhar a resolução de ponta a ponta;
  • Receber solicitação de atendimento do usuário por canais digitais para entender a demanda e prestar suporte técnico;
  • Entrar em contato com o usuário para validar o incidente/requisição descrito no chamado minimizando falhas no atendimento;
  • Encaminhar chamado não solucionado para a área responsável, relatando ocorrências na ferramenta e buscando nova resolução de problemas;
  • Encerrar chamado relatando as ocorrências no sistema para registrar evidência de atendimento;
  • Validar status dos chamados entrando em contato por canais digitais com os usuários para confirmar conclusão do atendimento;
  • Elaborar e revisar base de conhecimento com novos procedimentos técnicos com o objetivo de otimizar o serviço prestado;
  • Monitoramento contínuo para companhar proativa e reativamente os sistemas de TI, servidores, aplicativos, bancos de dados e a infraestrutura de rede (LAN/WAN), usando ferramentas de monitoramento (como Zabbix, Dynatrace ou Grafana) para detectar desvios de desempenho ou falhas;
  • Tomar medidas imediatas para resolver ou mitigar incidentes, o que pode envolver o acionamento equipes de plantão e ou empresas terceirizadas, para normalização dos serviços para restabelecer o ambiente original;
  • Acionar e colaborar com equipes de níveis superiores ou fornecedores externos quando os problemas exigem análises mais complexas como falhas ou troca de equipamentos;
  • Assegurar que os níveis de serviço (SLAs) acordados com os clientes ou áreas internas sejam atendidos, minimizando o tempo de inatividade;
  • Entendimento básico a intermediário de protocolos essenciais como TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, Telnet e SSH;
  • Compreensão de infraestruturas LAN/WAN e a capacidade de monitorar seu funcionamento e desempenho;
  • Habilidade em utilizar ferramentas básicas de diagnóstico, como ping e traceroute, para identificar e isolar problemas de conectividade;
  • Proficiência no uso de sistemas de gerenciamento e monitoramento de rede (ex: SolarWinds, Grafana, Zabbix), para detectar alertas e anomalias;


Hard Skills:

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Conhecimento com solução ITSM;
  • Conhecimento com processos ITIL.


Soft Skills:

  • Proatividade;
  • Força de vontade;
  • Empatia;
  • Agilidade;
  • Resiliência;


Por que fazer parte da Central IT?


Aqui você encontra mais do que benefícios, encontra um ambiente que acredita em pessoas, valoriza resultados e investe em evolução contínua:


Saúde e cuidado integral: planos médico e odontológico completos

title: Técnico de Operações TRS
description:
Vaga disponível inclusive para Pessoas com Deficiência ou Reabilitados pelo INSS.



Responsabilidades


▪ Utilizar as ferramentas de gerenciamento de Risco Operacionais da empresa, a fim de identificar e implementar controles para que a execução da tarefa seja realizada de forma segura;

▪ Realizar e/ou liderar a conferência dos equipamentos, através da utilização do formulário específico para o check list, a fim de garantir a funcionalidade operacional dos mesmos;

▪ Realizar e/ou liderar a preparação e teste dos equipamentos, seguindo o procedimento operacional, observando os requisitos de segurança, a fim de que os mesmos fiquem disponíveis para execução da operação;

▪ Orientar a equipe de suporte da plataforma na correta movimentação dos equipamentos, seguindo as normas de segurança, a fim de preservar a integridade física tanto do equipamento quanto das pessoas envolvidas na operação;

▪ Orientar e executar as operações de campo para instalação de equipamentos submarinos, seguindo os procedimentos operacionais, com foco em eficiência e segurança;

▪ Reportar possíveis anormalidades em equipamentos para a supervisão direta, para que não ocorram falhas e/ou incidentes operacionais;

▪ Realizar e/ou liderar a desmobilização dos equipamentos da sonda, seguindo as orientações de segurança, posicionando os equipamentos de forma correta dentro dos containers, para que os mesmos não sejam danificados durante a movimentação de cargas;

▪ Preencher os relatórios técnicos, conforme atividades desenvolvidas durante as etapas operacionais, seguindo os pré-requisitos estabelecidos no procedimento operacional;

▪ Identificar e propor melhorias relacionadas aos equipamentos e execução da operação, a fim de manter qualidade no serviço prestado e segurança para todos os envolvidos na tarefa;

▪ Realizar todos os treinamentos técnicos, obrigatórios da linha e da Companhia bem como cumprir todos os procedimentos operacionais, a fim de adquirir conhecimentos necessários para o desenvolvimento das atividades;

▪ Executar outras atividades correlatas;

▪ Manter limpo e organizado o local de trabalho;

▪ Utilizar os EPI´s conforme orientação do setor de segurança;

▪ Conhecer a Política de Qualidade, Meio Ambiente e Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional da empresa em ter a compreensão de como suas diretrizes influenciam as suas atividades na empresa;

▪ Ter conhecimento dos aspectos e impactos ambientais e perigos/riscos inerentes à sua área de trabalho e as ações desenvolvidas para controlá-los;


▪ Conhecer os elementos do SGI da empresa e sua aplicabilidade em seu ambiente de trabalho.



Pré-requisitos:


  • Curso técnico completo em Mecânica, eletromecânica, mecatrônica, eletrotécnica, e áreas correlatas (CFT Ativo).
  • Conhecimentos básico e Hidráulica e pneumática;
  • Pacote office básico;
  • Experiência com leitura e interpretação de Desenho Técnico;
  • Experiência de pelo menos 3 anos consecutivos como Técnico de Operações de equipamentos de TRS.
  • Noções de instrumentação e automação;
  • Noções em elétrica;
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Boas habilidades de comunicação;
  • Orientação a resultados
  • Residir em Macaé ou região próxima.

description:
SAP ABAP Consultant

100% REMOTE

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning


At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.


This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.


Senior DevOps Engineer II


At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You’ll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.


What you’ll do for us


  • Design and implement deployment pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Gitlab, Ansible, Puppet, or similar to automate building, testing, and deployment processes
  • Manage and maintain the infrastructure for deployment pipelines, including servers, databases, load balancers, and other resources
  • Monitor the performance of applications deployed in production environments and troubleshoot any issues that arise
  • Ensure the security and compliance of the deployment process and applications, including implementing security measures such as SSL certificates, firewalls, and intrusion detection systems
  • Collaborate with developers to understand requirements, ensure alignment with the development process, and support successful deployment
  • Continuously improve deployment processes through automation, identifying and implementing opportunities for efficiency gains
  • Provide support to customers and end-users as needed, including troubleshooting and resolving issues related to deployed applications
  • Work with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful and timely deployment of software applications
  • Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support for our platform
  • Have the ability and flexibility to work with teams globally, across time zones


What you’ll have


  • 5+ years of experience in a deployment role and a Masters Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management OR 7+ years of experience in a deployment role with a Bachelor’s degree.
  • Certification in any of the following: AWS, Azure, GCP or K8
  • Experience deploying and maintaining applications in any one of the clouds (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Experience with cloud-based environments like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Experience with Dockers or similar and experience with Kubernetes or similar
  • Strong technical skills in automation, continuous integration, and deployment practices
  • Working knowledge with Jenkins, Ansible, Terraform, etc.
  • Administration of databases (MS SQL, Mongo)
  • Working knowledge with Linux and Windows operating systems


What We Offer


  • Competitive Salary – We recognize and reward talent.
  • Tech Tools – Choose a Windows or PC laptop, whatever helps you work best.
  • Flexible Work – Work from home two days a week—less commuting, more time for what matters.
  • Supportive Team – Work alongside a diverse, talented team you can learn from every day.
  • Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
  • Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.


How the process works


  • Apply – Submit your application by clicking the Link below.
  • Initial Contact – Our recruiter will connect with you via video or phone call to discuss the role and understand your background.
  • Online Assessment – (If Applicable)
  • During the interview phase, you will meet with the technical panel for 60 minutes. We will contact you after the interview to let you know if we’d like to progress your application.
  • Tech Round 1 – An initial technical discussion to evaluate your skills and expertise.
  • Tech Round 2 – A deeper technical assessment to understand your approach and proficiency.
  • Managerial Round – A conversation with the hiring manager to evaluate collaboration, team fit, and growth potential.
  • HR Round – A final discussion on company culture, expectations, and career progression.


More about us…


At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.


With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.


o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning


At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.


This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.


Senior DevOps Engineer II


At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You’ll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.


What you’ll do for us


  • Design and implement deployment pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Gitlab, Ansible, Puppet, or similar to automate building, testing, and deployment processes
  • Manage and maintain the infrastructure for deployment pipelines, including servers, databases, load balancers, and other resources
  • Monitor the performance of applications deployed in production environments and troubleshoot any issues that arise
  • Ensure the security and compliance of the deployment process and applications, including implementing security measures such as SSL certificates, firewalls, and intrusion detection systems
  • Collaborate with developers to understand requirements, ensure alignment with the development process, and support successful deployment
  • Continuously improve deployment processes through automation, identifying and implementing opportunities for efficiency gains
  • Provide support to customers and end-users as needed, including troubleshooting and resolving issues related to deployed applications
  • Work with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful and timely deployment of software applications
  • Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support for our platform
  • Have the ability and flexibility to work with teams globally, across time zones


What you’ll have


  • 5+ years of experience in a deployment role and a Masters Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Management OR 7+ years of experience in a deployment role with a Bachelor’s degree.
  • Certification in any of the following: AWS, Azure, GCP or K8
  • Experience deploying and maintaining applications in any one of the clouds (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Experience with cloud-based environments like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Experience with Dockers or similar and experience with Kubernetes or similar
  • Strong technical skills in automation, continuous integration, and deployment practices
  • Working knowledge with Jenkins, Ansible, Terraform, etc.
  • Administration of databases (MS SQL, Mongo)
  • Working knowledge with Linux and Windows operating systems


What We Offer


  • Competitive Salary – We recognize and reward talent.
  • Tech Tools – Choose a Windows or PC laptop, whatever helps you work best.
  • Flexible Work – Work from home two days a week—less commuting, more time for what matters.
  • Supportive Team – Work alongside a diverse, talented team you can learn from every day.
  • Diversity & Inclusion – We celebrate our international workforce and value different perspectives.
  • Food & Drink – Enjoy healthy snacks, fresh fruit, teas, and coffees.


How the process works


  • Apply – Submit your application by clicking the Link below.
  • Initial Contact – Our recruiter will connect with you via video or phone call to discuss the role and understand your background.
  • Online Assessment – (If Applicable)
  • During the interview phase, you will meet with the technical panel for 60 minutes. We will contact you after the interview to let you know if we’d like to progress your application.
  • Tech Round 1 – An initial technical discussion to evaluate your skills and expertise.
  • Tech Round 2 – A deeper technical assessment to understand your approach and proficiency.
  • Managerial Round – A conversation with the hiring manager to evaluate collaboration, team fit, and growth potential.
  • HR Round – A final discussion on company culture, expectations, and career progression.


More about us…


At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.


With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.


o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

Provisionar e gerenciar infraestrutura na GCP

Criar, configurar e otimizar recursos como Compute Engine, GKE, VPCs, subnets, firewalls, VPNs e soluções híbridas, garantindo alta disponibilidade e eficiência de custos.

Automatizar infraestrutura e operações com IaC e scripts

Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código usando Terraform (incluindo Terraform Enterprise), além de automações com Python e Bash para padronização e escalabilidade dos ambientes.

Garantir segurança, controle de acesso e compliance

Definir e administrar IAM, políticas de acesso, criptografia com Cloud KMS e gerenciamento de segredos usando HashiCorp Vault, assegurando aderência a requisitos regulatórios.

Implantar e operar workloads containerizados e CI/CD

Containerizar aplicações com Docker, orquestrar deployments em Kubernetes e integrar pipelines de CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins ou Cloud Build) para entregas contínuas e confiáveis.

Monitorar ambientes, responder incidentes e otimizar performance

Implementar monitoramento e logging com Cloud Monitoring (Stackdriver), Prometheus e Grafana, atuando na resposta a incidentes e na melhoria contínua da performance e resiliência dos sistemas.


O que você precisa ter

  • Inglês avançado para conversação
  • GCP
  • Kubernetes (GKE)
  • Docker
  • Terraform


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!


Benefícios para você:

  • Plano de saúde.
  • Vale Alimentação.
  • Vale Refeição.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Plano odontológico.
  • Gympass.
  • Meu Pet Club.


Além disso, oferecemos:

  • Incentivo a estudo após 1 ano de Dexian.
  • Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos.
  • Formação através de Trilha de Liderança.

title: Senior Medical Advisor
description:
At Biocon Biologics, we are creating a model for the future of healthcare for all. We are a leading company in the biosimilars revolution where patients come first. Our ambition is to impact a billion lives and we do this by fostering a culture of affordable innovation, patient-centricity, and disruptive thinking. We are a multicultural global company where employees have a purpose and passion to work closely with partners and patients. We have a long-term commitment to bringing high-quality affordable biosimilars to patients all over the globe. We have proven end-to-end expertise from clone development, manufacturing, clinical development, and regulatory approvals to commercialization in developed and emerging markets.



Role: Sr Medical Advisor, Medical Affairs

Location- São Paulo, Brazil


We are seeking a candidate in Brazil Region as Medical Advisor within the Clinical Development and Medical Affairs organization. Reporting to the EM Head of Medical Affairs; the Medical Advisor will be involved in KOL engagement/ HCP interactions and provide Scientific support to KOLs /HCP to execute the core medico marketing strategies as well as support with Pharmacovigilance activities.


Responsibilities


  • Build a network of key opinion leaders through enhanced scientific interfaces and best practices
  • Engage and build robust relationships with HCPs, and KOLs on value, access, and pharmaco-economic areas, also seek advice on unmet needs for patients and other stakeholders
  • Develop/validate appropriate scientific content for conferences, briefing meetings & other policy-related activities/initiatives
  • Assist in the planning of new campaigns and launch activities
  • Be a brand ambassador for Biocon Biologics and its products
  • Safeguard patient benefit always through the application of relevant knowledge of science, regulations, and compliance in all initiatives undertaken by the organization
  • Prepare educational material/ videos/ website content/ patient information leaflets in collaboration with the medical affairs Centre of Excellence and marketing for relevant therapies.
  • Ideate evidence generation through IITs and registries in line with strategy, addressing concerns/feedback from the HCPs, patients, and other stakeholders
  • Author publications/blogs/white papers related to the value and differentiation of our products
  • Collaborate with the training team in updating and reviewing slide decks/manuals and other relevant materials
  • Promote patient centricity within Biocon Biologics
  • Provide valid scientific responses to all the medical queries from the customers regarding the products and therapy area involved
  • Promote diversity & inclusion in clinical trials, and data and get involved in ESG objectives as it pertains to medical affairs
  • Together with the global teams, formulate meaningful real-world evidence studies, and support clinical strategy and execution related to registration and post-registration clinical trials.
  • “Responsible for local Pharmacovigilance communications for the Pharmacovigilance System of the Registration Holder of Medicament
  • To have oversight of the Pharmacovigilance system of the PRH/MAH in terms of structure and performance and to ensure directly or through supervision that the system components and processes are in place.
  • Thorough understanding of the safety profiles of the products under the responsibility of the Medication Registration Holder
  • Reside in Brazilian territory and be available to attend PV-related requirements and inspections.
  • Promote inclusions and suggestions in the Risk Management Plans and Periodic Benefit-Risk Assessment Reports
  • Ensure adequate and timely submission of expedited adverse reaction reports, PBRERs and other safety reports to the regulatory agencies as per applicable local regulations.
  • To have oversight on weekly literature searches and to report the valid ICSRs to the regulatory agency in the territory as per the applicable regulations.
  • To alert the Authority of any emerging safety issue(s) involving registered products. ”


Other basic requirements include:


  • Ability to interact with senior internal and external personnel
  • Attention to detail and taking accountability
  • Ability to work across more than a few therapy areas
  • Create sense of purpose and inspiration in the team
  • Must be able to work in a team environment, working closely with cross-functional teams
  • Collaborate with medical affairs colleagues in other countries/regions and share knowledge and learnings
  • Functional expertise in MS office, Veeva Vault
  • Substantial knowledge and understanding of policies, procedures, and guidelines relevant to medical affairs operations
  • Substantial knowledge of HCP policies and regulations
  • Proven understanding of the needs of individuals living with cancer and chronic diseases like diabetes or other autoimmune diseases as well as pressing public health issues, including at the pharmacy and HCP levels.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred (e.g., MS, Pharm D, Ph.D., or MD);
  • Minimum 05 years of medical affairs, patient access, and advocacy experience in the biopharmaceutical, or relevant non-profit or payer industry.
  • Must be willing and able to travel (approximately 30%) regionally, including to other countries within the EM region.



Biocon Biologics is an Equal Opportunity, EEO / Affirmative Action Employer committed to excellence through diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and no employee shall be discriminated against because of their race, color, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability, genetic information, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

title: Tasks Management Specialist - Remote

Enjoy the opportunity to have a dynamic lifestyle, better health, and wellness. Find renewed passion in your job, improve your productivity, and benefit from attractive growth opportunities for your career.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior Medical Advisor
description:
At Biocon Biologics, we are creating a model for the future of healthcare for all. We are a leading company in the biosimilars revolution where patients come first. Our ambition is to impact a billion lives and we do this by fostering a culture of affordable innovation, patient-centricity, and disruptive thinking. We are a multicultural global company where employees have a purpose and passion to work closely with partners and patients. We have a long-term commitment to bringing high-quality affordable biosimilars to patients all over the globe. We have proven end-to-end expertise from clone development, manufacturing, clinical development, and regulatory approvals to commercialization in developed and emerging markets.



Role: Sr Medical Advisor, Medical Affairs

Location- São Paulo, Brazil


We are seeking a candidate in Brazil Region as Medical Advisor within the Clinical Development and Medical Affairs organization. Reporting to the EM Head of Medical Affairs; the Medical Advisor will be involved in KOL engagement/ HCP interactions and provide Scientific support to KOLs /HCP to execute the core medico marketing strategies as well as support with Pharmacovigilance activities.


Responsibilities


  • Build a network of key opinion leaders through enhanced scientific interfaces and best practices
  • Engage and build robust relationships with HCPs, and KOLs on value, access, and pharmaco-economic areas, also seek advice on unmet needs for patients and other stakeholders
  • Develop/validate appropriate scientific content for conferences, briefing meetings & other policy-related activities/initiatives
  • Assist in the planning of new campaigns and launch activities
  • Be a brand ambassador for Biocon Biologics and its products
  • Safeguard patient benefit always through the application of relevant knowledge of science, regulations, and compliance in all initiatives undertaken by the organization
  • Prepare educational material/ videos/ website content/ patient information leaflets in collaboration with the medical affairs Centre of Excellence and marketing for relevant therapies.
  • Ideate evidence generation through IITs and registries in line with strategy, addressing concerns/feedback from the HCPs, patients, and other stakeholders
  • Author publications/blogs/white papers related to the value and differentiation of our products
  • Collaborate with the training team in updating and reviewing slide decks/manuals and other relevant materials
  • Promote patient centricity within Biocon Biologics
  • Provide valid scientific responses to all the medical queries from the customers regarding the products and therapy area involved
  • Promote diversity & inclusion in clinical trials, and data and get involved in ESG objectives as it pertains to medical affairs
  • Together with the global teams, formulate meaningful real-world evidence studies, and support clinical strategy and execution related to registration and post-registration clinical trials.
  • “Responsible for local Pharmacovigilance communications for the Pharmacovigilance System of the Registration Holder of Medicament
  • To have oversight of the Pharmacovigilance system of the PRH/MAH in terms of structure and performance and to ensure directly or through supervision that the system components and processes are in place.
  • Thorough understanding of the safety profiles of the products under the responsibility of the Medication Registration Holder
  • Reside in Brazilian territory and be available to attend PV-related requirements and inspections.
  • Promote inclusions and suggestions in the Risk Management Plans and Periodic Benefit-Risk Assessment Reports
  • Ensure adequate and timely submission of expedited adverse reaction reports, PBRERs and other safety reports to the regulatory agencies as per applicable local regulations.
  • To have oversight on weekly literature searches and to report the valid ICSRs to the regulatory agency in the territory as per the applicable regulations.
  • To alert the Authority of any emerging safety issue(s) involving registered products. ”


Other basic requirements include:


  • Ability to interact with senior internal and external personnel
  • Attention to detail and taking accountability
  • Ability to work across more than a few therapy areas
  • Create sense of purpose and inspiration in the team
  • Must be able to work in a team environment, working closely with cross-functional teams
  • Collaborate with medical affairs colleagues in other countries/regions and share knowledge and learnings
  • Functional expertise in MS office, Veeva Vault
  • Substantial knowledge and understanding of policies, procedures, and guidelines relevant to medical affairs operations
  • Substantial knowledge of HCP policies and regulations
  • Proven understanding of the needs of individuals living with cancer and chronic diseases like diabetes or other autoimmune diseases as well as pressing public health issues, including at the pharmacy and HCP levels.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred (e.g., MS, Pharm D, Ph.D., or MD);
  • Minimum 05 years of medical affairs, patient access, and advocacy experience in the biopharmaceutical, or relevant non-profit or payer industry.
  • Must be willing and able to travel (approximately 30%) regionally, including to other countries within the EM region.



Biocon Biologics is an Equal Opportunity, EEO / Affirmative Action Employer committed to excellence through diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and no employee shall be discriminated against because of their race, color, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability, genetic information, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.
